sourceResearch.title: Official 2023 park map
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Use a legible gate street, clustered family/thrill districts, distributed food, a park-circulation ride, and a separately serviced water-park zone.

sourceResearch.title: Adventureland rides
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Balance family, classic, indoor and major-thrill attractions; do not make a park that is only one coaster.

sourceResearch.title: Adventure Bay
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Provide wave, river, slide and young-family water experiences as distinct operating zones.

sourceResearch.title: Official 2026 Worlds of Fun and Oceans of Fun map
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Use paired but independently operable gates, themed districts, a circulation loop, water-park bathhouses, first aid, guest services and distributed support.

sourceResearch.title: Official park overview
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Create several original districts and a complete day-to-night mix rather than copying branded rides or iconography.

sourceResearch.title: Chapter 10: Amusement Rides
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Every load/unload area and queue receives a continuous accessible route, turning space and signed access; the primary path target is no steeper than 1:12.

sourceResearch.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sourceResearch.title: 2024 Model Aquatic Health Code
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Every active pool is a separately containable shell with a represented plant room, isolation, barriers, inspection access, depth marking and night lighting.

sourceResearch.organization: United States Consumer Product Safety Commission
sourceResearch.title: Amusement rides and adventure-attraction voluntary standards
sourceResearch.designTranslation: Treat track, supports, station, evacuation walk and maintenance access as one engineered object; decorative track alone is not acceptable.

surveyedParcels.name: Northwind Water Gardens
surveyedParcels.designResponse: Pile-supported public deck at support Y64, with every active aquatic venue in its own exact-state contained shell. Existing open water remains visual water, not an unbounded swimming venue.

surveyedParcels.name: Ravencrest Adventure Grounds
surveyedParcels.designResponse: Use the ridge as the coaster and landmark terrain; place the family district on the gentler east terrace and connect Y68, Y76 and Y84 terraces with long slab ramps and switchbacks.

surveyedParcels.name: Adventure Exchange shared arrival
surveyedParcels.designResponse: Build a pile-and-causeway arrival floor at support Y67, standing Y68, with a raised pedestrian table across the parkway.

surveyedParcels.name: Harborlight Courts lakeside housing
surveyedParcels.designResponse: Medium-density gabled court buildings with public lake frontage, planted thresholds and attached four- or six-bay shared garage wings.

protectedSourceState.name: Surface ruined-portal fabric and empty chest
protectedSourceState.rule: Preserve every source cell and the chest. The park may add only a freestanding overlook path outside the no-target envelope.
No water-park pile, utility or excavation may extend below Y38; these cells remain untouched.
No dry-park excavation may extend below Y55 in this quadrant; these cells remain untouched.
The crater-lake package must preserve this subsurface cell and prove that basin containment has no route to it.

approachExtension.name: North Shore Parkway and Causeway

tieIn.rule: The only intentional existing-feature intersection is the surveyed tie-in apron.

engineering: Use pile bents and explicit bridge spans where the baseline contains water at Y62; do not mass-fill the lagoon.
Keep the full corridor south of Z=-652 along the westbound leg so the stadium boundary at Z=-640 remains untouched.
Provide a five-block clear emergency/greenway route independent of the carriageway.
Grade transitions no faster than one full block per twelve horizontal blocks on the primary accessible route.

routes.serviceRule: The outer service loop may cross the guest system only at the controlled Gate Terrace crossing.

rules: The public crater loop stays outside all ticketed park boundaries.
The parkway crosses the greenbelt north of the crater and does not turn the lake into a traffic island.
No lake package may target the protected chest at (-494,39,-555) or open a subsurface water path to it.

lakesideHousing.name: Harborlight Courts
lakesideHousing.style: original medium-density coastal-gabled neighborhood with light masonry, timber, slate/copper roofs, porches, hedges and public waterfront access
rules: Every garage is physically attached to its parent building.
The large south court receives six clear bays; the two smaller court buildings receive four clear bays each.
No private parcel or garage interrupts the continuous public lake walk.
Garage doors address Bayberry Lane or a service mews, never the lake.

requiredRelations: every queue/load/service/evacuation route to its attraction
every active water shell to its plant/isolation record
every dwelling room and attached garage to its parent building
every screenshot and floor plan to the exact object it depicts

releaseGates: Fresh same-moment immutable snapshot and hash.
Exact-cell forward and reverse packages; no old forward file replay.
Zero unreviewed database-feature, block-entity, fluid-neighbor or cross-package targets.
Entity/player clearance and a fixed coordinated transaction order.
Contained-water simulation proving no leak to natural water, caves or protected block entities.
Coaster/slide support, clearance, queue, evacuation and service-route independent QA.
Bidirectional normal-walk QA for every gate, primary loop, attraction load area, greenway, housing street and lake path.
Post snapshot, exact-state census, matched maps/captures and database import integrity.
Sites and Box publication only after the physical and documentary release is accepted.
